Title: CI: Use in-memory secrets store for tests (BITWARDEN_INMEMORY_SECRETS=1)

Body:
- Add `BITWARDEN_INMEMORY_SECRETS=1` to the `build-and-test` job in `.github/workflows/dotnet-test.yml`.
- This ensures the test job registers the `InMemorySecretStore` and avoids OS-specific keyring calls on GH Actions runners.
- Included a short changelog entry in `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased.

Notes:
- Tests already set the env override when running locally in test setup; adding this to the workflow guarantees CI stability across OS matrix.
